question:
A word in the following sentence is INCORRECTLY spelt. Select that word from the given options.

Mesing up your laundry or being late for work is not very important when you consider your entire life.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"mesing"** is incorrectly spelt. It should be **"messing"**.
 
• **"Messing"** means to make untidy or dirty or to interfere with something in a way that causes problems. (गड़बड़ करना)
 
 
• Example: Stop messing around and focus on your work.
 
 

**​**Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Entire **(पूरा): Refers to the whole of something.

 
 
• **Example:** She spent the **entire **day cleaning the house.
 
 
 
• **Laundry **(कपड़े धोना): Refers to clothes and linens that need to be washed or that have been newly washed.
 
 
• **Example: **I need to do the **laundry **this weekend.
 
 
 
• **Important** (महत्वपूर्ण): Refers to something of great significance or value.
 
 
• **Example:** It is **important **to drink enough water every day.
 
 

3a:Tca4,

The correct answer is: Option 1</b&g
